overview: The Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee met to review the city's capital debt plan and projected tax impacts, examine updated Preferred Schematic Report (PSR) cost estimates, and evaluate a 50-year life cycle cost analysis comparing HVAC systems.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the previous meeting with a spelling correction.

items.title: Project Updates and MSBA Collaboration
items.summary: Jenny Graham reported on a productive meeting with the MSBA, clarifying that a requested study of a 9-12 only option was purely for comparison and that the agency is satisfied with the city's handling of the site's deed restriction.

items.title: City Capital Projects and Cost Impact Presentation
items.summary: Medford city administrators presented the municipal capital plan and projected tax impacts of potential high school debt exclusions, prompting a lengthy discussion with the committee and public regarding project scope, residential tax burdens, and municipal spending priorities.

items.title: PSR Cost Estimates Review
items.summary: The project team presented updated Preferred Schematic Report cost estimates for the revised C2.2a and C3.4a design options, ranging from $716 million to $817 million depending on the selected program scope.

items.title: Project Timeline Review
items.summary: The project team reviewed the key milestones leading up to the submission of the Preferred Schematic Report and the anticipated citywide vote in May 2027.

items.title: Evaluation Criteria and Life Cycle Cost Analysis
items.summary: The project team presented the updated evaluation criteria matrix and a 50-year life cycle cost analysis comparing geothermal ground-source and air-to-water heat pump systems, including their respective carbon and solar PV impacts.
